pitfalls: Caching the owner's groups for hours: the owner is fired, the agent keeps reading. Symptom: a deprovisioned user's agent still returns results

layout: brain/quota/bucket.lua : atomic two-bucket check and debit
brain/quota/meter.py : 1 s batch writer to op_cost
tests/test_quota.py : refill, deny and settle tests
ll_quota.interface:
def allow(tenant_id: str, agent_id: str, route: str, cost: float) -> Decision  # Decision(ok, retry_after_s)
def settle(tenant_id: str, agent_id: str, estimated: float, actual: float) -> None  # refund or charge the difference
ll_quota.code:
LUA = """
local function refill(key, rate, burst, now)
  local h = redis.call('HMGET', key, 'tokens', 'ts')
  local t = tonumber(h[1]) or burst
  local ts = tonumber(h[2]) or now
  return math.min(burst, t + rate * (now - ts) / 1000)
end
local now = tonumber(ARGV[1]); local c = tonumber(ARGV[2])
local a = refill(KEYS[1], tonumber(ARGV[3]), tonumber(ARGV[4]), now)
local t = refill(KEYS[2], tonumber(ARGV[5]), tonumber(ARGV[6]), now)
if a < c or t < c then
  local short = math.max(c - a, c - t)
  local rate = (a < c) and tonumber(ARGV[3]) or tonumber(ARGV[5])
  return {0, math.ceil(short / rate)}
end
redis.call('HSET', KEYS[1], 'tokens', a - c, 'ts', now)
redis.call('HSET', KEYS[2], 'tokens', t - c, 'ts', now)
redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[1], 3600); redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[2], 3600)
return {1, 0}
"""
class Limiter:
    def __init__(self, r, cfg):
        self.s, self.cfg = r.register_script(LUA), cfg
    def allow(self, tenant, agent, route, cost):
        now = int(time.time() * 1000)   # use Redis TIME in production to avoid clock skew
        ok, wait = self.s(keys=[f"quota:{tenant}:agent:{agent}", f"quota:{tenant}:tenant"],
            args=[now, cost, self.cfg.agent_rate, self.cfg.agent_burst,
                  self.cfg.tenant_rate, self.cfg.tenant_burst])
        return Decision(bool(ok), int(wait))
    def settle(self, tenant, agent, estimated, actual):
        delta = estimated - actual      # positive refunds, negative charges
        if delta:
            self.s_adjust(tenant, agent, delta)

pitfalls: Read then write in app code races: two replicas both see 1 token and both allow. Symptom: limit exceeded by a factor of the replica count. Use the Lua script
Charging the estimate and never settling: long answers are undercharged and short ones overcharged. Symptom: cost meter and bucket drift apart
Clock skew between app nodes breaks refill math; take time from Redis TIME

CREATE TABLE subscription (
  sub_id text PRIMARY KEY,
  agent_id text NOT NULL,
  tenant_id text NOT NULL,
  selector jsonb NOT NULL,
  delivery jsonb NOT NULL,
  min_interval_s int NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
  cursor_event_id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE TABLE delivery_attempt (
  sub_id text NOT NULL,
  event_id bigint NOT NULL,
  doc_id text NOT NULL,
  attempt int NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL,
  at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (sub_id, event_id, attempt)
);
ll_sub.interface:
POST /subscriptions  {agent_id, selector:{entity_ids[]|topic}, delivery:{url|mcp}, min_interval_s}  ->  201 {sub_id}
Push body: {event_id, sub_id, doc_id, op, version, uri, ts}
